description: Place an outbound AI phone call FOR A LEAD via the connected AI-Call-Bot, and keep the bookkeeping here: the lead's number is used, the lead (and campaign) id travels to the bot as external_ref, and a row in the lead's timeline is written whether the call starts or fails. REAL ACTION — it dials a person. Required: lead_id, phone_number_id (the bot's owned number to call FROM, see acb__list_phone_numbers). Optional: campaign_id, ai_prompt_id (defaults to the number's prompt), to_number (overrides the lead's), notes. Use acb__start_outgoing_call instead only when the call belongs to no lead. Afterwards call sync_bot_calls to pull the result and transcript.
name: start_bot_call
